name: business-os-cloudflare
description: Business OS on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + Queues (Docker-free runtime)

scripts.dev: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler dev --local --var BUSINESS_OS_LOCAL_DEV:1 --config wrangler.toml
scripts.test:plan-tier: node scripts/test-plan-tier-pure.cjs && node scripts/test-wrangler-config-drift-pure.cjs && node scripts/test-queue-fallback-pure.cjs && node scripts/test-plan-tier-surfaces-pure.cjs
scripts.migrate:local: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:remote: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:import:local: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply IMPORT_DB --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:import:remote: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply IMPORT_DB --remote --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:full: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend && npm run migrate:remote && npm run migrate:import:remote && npm run secrets:sync && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:full:free: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend && npm run migrate:remote && npm run migrate:import:remote && npm run secrets:sync && npm run deploy:free
scripts.dry-run:paid: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-dry-run-paid --config wrangler.toml
scripts.dry-run:free: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-dry-run-free --config wrangler.free.toml
scripts.d1:shell:local: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 execute DB --local --config wrangler.toml --command
scripts.d1:shell:remote: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config wrangler.toml --command
